items.title: Strategic Priority - Equitable Services and Opportunities
HRC-TCE-24-001, Accessibility Status Report
notes:
In response to a question from the Committee, Kim Bellissimo, Commissioner of Human Resources & Citizen Services, acknowledged direction for staff to explore the potential for additional consultations with various organizations to enhance future accessibility status updates.

Responding to questions, K. Bellissimo stated the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) aims to make the province fully accessible by 2025. Many organizations have made significant strides in enhancing accessibility. However, it remains uncertain if anyone can fully attain the goal of making Ontario entirely barrier-free.

Jennifer Walker, Program Manager of Client Experience, clarified that the Cambridge Accessibility Advisory Committee (CAAC) is indeed consulted by Regional staff when undertaking projects in collaboration with Cambridge.
